title: Dez Cadeiras
summary: The Riot League video (filmed in episode-096) is published the night before this episode, confirming its in-universe release date as 2027-01-07, and its reception -- fans reacting as much to Kite's piano and 0bit's consoles as to champion picks -- gives Dust2.us the idea to film a similar feature with Kairos's ten Counter-Strike players (Main and Academy). Adrian agrees to a 40-minute filmed session during training; it runs 1 hour 12 minutes. All ten players answer favorite map, one-weapon-forever, and pre-Kairos personal background, plus informal team-banter rapid-fire questions between Main and Academy. The episode ends with Adrian privately opening a new, unbudgeted, unannounced folder on his computer titled 'KAIROS COMMONS,' with the note 'What were they before they became players?'
keyEvents: The Riot League feature (filmed 2027-01-05 in episode-096) is confirmed published the night before this episode, i.e. 2027-01-07; fan reaction focuses heavily on personal trivia (Kite's piano, 0bit's consoles, 404's keyboards, japalenogrits's choir background) rather than only gameplay content.
Dust2.us reaches out to Adrian the same morning proposing an equivalent Counter-Strike feature; Adrian agrees to a 40-minute window during training (it ultimately runs 1h12m).

All ten CS players (Main: Atlas, Glacier, MoteConHuesillo, Mold, FLACOGOMEZ; Academy: RAMENSOUP, velcroDAWG, p4rkingl0t, dentalplan, wrongnumber) are seated for filming -- five black chairs for Main, five green for Academy.

Favorite map: Atlas - Inferno ('the map makes you communicate, you can't hide behind mechanics forever'); Glacier - Nuke (despite being the team's AWPer, 'especially because I'm an AWPer,' citing info/rotation/sound/vertical pressure); MoteConHuesillo - Cobblestone (admits it isn't even the pool's best map, just his favorite); Mold - Dust II; FLACOGOMEZ - Train. Academy: RAMENSOUP - Nuke; velcroDAWG - Inferno; p4rkingl0t - Train; dentalplan - Dust II; wrongnumber - Overpass.

One weapon forever: Mold, Atlas, and MoteConHuesillo all choose the AK; FLACOGOMEZ chooses the M4A1-S; Glacier, the team's primary AWPer, chooses the AWP, to teammates' visible relief. Academy: RAMENSOUP and velcroDAWG choose AK; p4rkingl0t chooses AK after almost picking the M4; dentalplan chooses AWP; wrongnumber chooses M4A1-S.

Pre-Kairos personal background, Main: Atlas played ice hockey (defenseman) and still watches NHL; also enjoys large (1000-2000 piece) jigsaw puzzles. Glacier worked a few hours a week at a convenience store (stock, register, cleaning) and is interested in military history (strategy, logistics, old campaigns specifically, not weapons or collecting). MoteConHuesillo played futsal for years (winger) and cooks Mexican food learned from his family. Mold, after initially deflecting, admits to walking desert trails for hours without music or a podcast, and reveals he draws (mostly cars, buildings, and faces) but refuses to show any of it on camera. FLACOGOMEZ also played futsal and has followed Brazilian football (specifically Palmeiras) since childhood, and collects football jerseys ('about twenty,' likely more).

Pre-Kairos personal background, Academy: RAMENSOUP did competitive school debate and cooks real ramen from scratch (broth and toppings, not instant). velcroDAWG plays basketball and speaks enough Serbian to talk with part of his family. p4rkingl0t likes cars, models, engines, and sound, and has done nighttime automotive photography for friends (parking lots, gas stations, city lights). dentalplan played drums for four years. wrongnumber did three school theater productions, none as lead; the two are revealed as twins, and they immediately and simultaneously dispute, on camera, who is older (dentalplan says eleven minutes, wrongnumber says nine), which is never resolved.

An unscripted closing round has both teams rapid-fire guessing things about each other (who stays up latest, worst musical taste, who'd survive alone in a forest, who'd get arrested first on a trip); RAMENSOUP claims forest survival skill from six months as a scout, which p4rkingl0t immediately disputes as insufficient.

After filming, Adrian privately opens a new folder on his computer, unbudgeted and unannounced, titled 'KAIROS COMMONS,' with the note 'What were they before they became players?' -- the first appearance of the concept that becomes the Kairos Commons facility (see episode-100).
consequences: The Dust2.us interview footage becomes the source material for a Kairospedia archive feature; its real-world outlet publication date is never confirmed in-universe and remains unknown/null.
Adrian's private 'KAIROS COMMONS' folder is the direct origin of the Kairos Commons facility opened in episode-100.
